principle: one semantic state; many deterministic task-, audience-, device- and domain-appropriate projections
authority_rule: views never become semantic authority merely because they are convenient, public, visual or editable

shared_view_families.purpose: familiar folder-like navigation and scope browsing
shared_view_families.note: presentation of graph topology, not a separate folder authority

shared_view_families.purpose: operational dashboards using collapsed control + expanded canonical detail
progressive disclosure from whole filespace to pillar to programme/function
deep inspect of one object without losing semantic halo
requirements, interfaces, gates, risks, contradictions and coverage
geometry/component twin view bound to semantic object IDs
shared_view_families.rule: geometry representation cannot override semantic/evidence authority
transient Host-local state is not canonical by visibility

shared_view_families.purpose: natural-language interaction that materialises the most suitable current view
shared_view_families.rule: chat may propose deltas but protected mutation follows normal authority/DBR path

cross_surface_spatiotemporal.purpose: One existing Cognigrex.cgx Object_ID selected from Chat, Maps, MPL globe, GMAT mission view, LS GO or workspace/dataspace resolves into a permission-checked, time-bound read-only projection; no parallel map store, mission master, public relay or runtime.

spatial_contract.constraint: Map coordinates and basemap imagery are visual context. Reproject/transform with source- and accuracy-qualified methods before engineering decisions. Geometry adjacency does not imply network connectivity, elevation equivalence or permission.

temporal_contract.recorded_at: time observation/source revision became known to CGX
temporal_contract.resolved_at: time an owner-reviewed interpretation or decision was accepted; may be absent
rules: Never silently replace a historical valid-time view with the latest recorded state.
Retain contradictory, superseded and unknown temporal states with provenance.
Require explicit time scale/frame/epoch for GMAT exports and time-bearing terrestrial sensors.
A timestamp alone does not verify signature, clock calibration, measurement independence or physical truth.

authority_and_flow.map: Discovery and 2D geographic representation; not GIS survey authority, owned persistence, mission propagation, risk method or physical transmitter.
authority_and_flow.mpl: Romer-MPL owns PRE_RELEASE Maximum Probable Loss screening and its documented heuristic/external hazard-geometry limitations; no regulatory approval by visual overlay.
authority_and_flow.gmat: Native GMAT owns named scenario, force model, frame, time system, propagation/event/state-vector receipt; browser animation or a labelled scenario is not a native GMAT run.
authority_and_flow.cgx: Existing FileSpace owns object/root and source identity; DataSpace transports only authorised verified deltas under existing leases/readbacks.
authority_and_flow.lightspeed: Existing installed Smith/LightSpeed executor owns typed queues and receipts; host-offline state cannot be inferred as a successful run.
authority_and_flow.guest: Existing #172 reviewer and #174 synthetic-only public presentation; no direct private API, host file path, unrestricted source/mesh, private content hash or canonical mutation.
interaction_steps: verify existing source/root and viewer authority server-side
select explicit spatial frame and valid/recorded epoch
project allowlisted existing lens and admitted evidence
route any approved write to separate owner Resolve and append-only DBR receipt

public_projection_constraints: Client-provided role, permission flag, release class, approved receipt or model hash never substitutes for trusted server-side verification.
Only owner-approved Public projections with attributable source rights, released content hash and current approval receipt may be served.
Response on withheld objects is non-enumerating; private roots, geometry, node roster and metadata are not disclosed through static assets.
No public execution, live network exchange, automatic GMAT/MPL calculation, deployment or root promotion is authorised by this facet.

alexandria_physical_boundary.semantic_graph: Dual-dodecahedral metaphor may organise concepts and relations; does not establish a geodetic or RF coverage mesh.
alexandria_physical_boundary.candidate_sites: Global capitals are possible research/administrative anchors, not measured backbone, powered nodes or legal spectrum rights.
alexandria_physical_boundary.australias_contingency: Australian sovereign primary and independent fallback domains are a resilience design objective, not demonstrated geographic coverage.
alexandria_physical_boundary.unverified: Biosphere resonant electromagnetic boundary, worldwide backscatter handshake and lone-node bridging remain physical hypotheses requiring approved sensors, RF link budgets, calibration, propagation measurements and independent tests.

acceptance_gates: JSON/lens registry and source-contract regression PASS at exact branch head
one owner-approved object selected consistently across two authorised views without root drift or private leakage
native GMAT run receipt with scenario/forces/frame/epoch and independent benchmark before claiming orbit accuracy
MPL current-source risk/browser receipt and independent required hazard geometry before regulatory parity
private static-asset negative tests, revoked guest tests and four-seat reviewer policy approvals under #158/#172
two separately authenticated devices with peer lease/sequence/replay/delta exact readback under #161
no physical radio/backscatter qualification until separately instrumented and legally authorised

rolling_observer.source: existing CGX DataSpace observation window; no separate source authority
rolling_observer.output: single shared observation produces nine local projections; no nine-fold independent-information claim
rolling_observer.operation: opt-in; 1s sampling, 5s phase, 60s rolling reconciliation, no required per-second RF transmit
rolling_observer.privacy: release_projection stays WITHHELD until distinct owner-approved publication policy and authorisation
rolling_observer.epistemic: OBSERVATIONAL_CANDIDATE; independent corroboration and physical model proof external to view

configurable_n_dataspace.basis: single canonical FileSpace model, sparse DataSpace observations and exact prior/context-root references
configurable_n_dataspace.interpretation: locally select task-appropriate views; one observation may feed many applications but cannot convey new independent information without new evidence
configurable_n_dataspace.geometric_disposition: coordinate frame, displacement, phase, geometry, quantiser baseline and model assumptions are attributes of source-governed geometry/model roots, not encryption secrets
configurable_n_dataspace.public_scope: do not expose private node rosters, sensitive geometry, internal roots or non-public source metadata
configurable_n_dataspace.procedural_binding: node_exchange.validate_dataspace_profile and build_dataspace_delta_candidate, no new render engine or object store

geometric_press_capacity_facet.purpose: Extend the existing UniSpace/CGX geometric Press and semantic projections to model occupied, reserved, neutral and expandable typed cells; reuse one FileSpace source graph, not a second datastore, application, print controller or master.
input_sources: current Object_ID / typed classes, aliases, parent-child relationships and source hash
authoritative geometry_root, source unit, coordinate frame and valid 2D polygon or 3D closed mesh
explicit user scope, preferred licensed lenses, current permissions and device rendering capabilities
measured utilization, estimated demand, environment constraints and uncertainty when actually sourced
scoped observer identities and independently supported observations (not derived public symbol keys)

user_interaction.entry: existing desktop Web2 Press/no-publish or existing LS GO view; source-to-executable match required before activation
user_interaction.geometric_seed: user chooses 3..128 sides; n=4 regular seed is an exact square, not a volume
operations: left-click or touch add/select typed cell
edit vertex, edge or angle with explicit selected constraints
choose data imprint layers and family-owned semantic lenses
preview before storing a proposed source-bound delta
export or share only a classified projection with a separate release receipt
validation: positive signed area for expected winding
no self-intersections or degenerate zero-length edges
explicit m / m2 / m3 and frame where physical
depth>0 or closed orientable 3D boundary before computing physical volume
lossless serialization of declared geometry fields
user_interaction.display_symbols: base-2..36 numerals, letters and glyphs are optional encodings/aliases; not cryptographic keys, physical constants or new independent observations
user_interaction.calculations: logarithm base b is a declared numerical-model choice with b>0 and b!=1; independent of number of sides

cell_states.OCCUPIED: committed source-backed object footprint and access scope
cell_states.RESERVED: bounded allocation with reason, owner, expiry and estimated utilization
cell_states.FREE: measured geometry with no current allocation; not automatically authorized for publication or execution
cell_states.GROWTH_CANDIDATE: modelled demand buffer, not yet physically or canonically assigned
cell_states.NEUTRAL_UNBOUND: valid neutral placeholder awaiting class, material, capability or owner decision
cell_states.UNKNOWN: absent or incompatible evidence; must not be interpreted as empty/free/zero
cell_states.WITHHELD: known existence or relationships may be non-disclosable; return non-enumerating safe view
cell_states.CONFLICT: concurrent geometry/source/allocation revisions disagree; no silent overwrite

allocation_and_allometry.method: derive effective occupied capacity and resource costs from exact geometry plus independently sourced task/resource constraints, then propose selective local cell splitting, adjacency and boundary reflow without changing original source bytes
allocation_and_allometry.model: y=k*x^alpha may be used ONLY for a specified domain, measured/calibrated k and alpha, comparable units, valid size interval and confidence interval; otherwise UNSUPPORTED_MODEL and deterministic bounded scenario sweep
costs: inter-cell interfaces and graph edge updates
allocation_and_allometry.objective: minimize weighted reflow + transfer + execution + risk cost subject to geometry validity, hard permissions, pinned source/revision constraints and reserve limits; compare with no-reflow baseline
allocation_and_allometry.evidence_ceiling: forecasts/allometric analogy do not prove biological law, astrophysical relation, material compatibility or physical machinery readiness
replanning_triggers: source hash or geometry root changed
allocation_and_allometry.replication: DNA-like templating is an analogy for source-hashed reusable recipes and reversible graph forks: no overwrite of parent, duplicate secret, clone of physical material, or lineage deletion
allocation_and_allometry.deduplication: same source sha256 may reuse immutable bytes and cache; distinct Object_ID authority, licence, history, physical state and child provenance remain separate; merge views by reference only

family_profiles.Cognigrex: FileSpace source/custodial grammar, DataSpace semantic resolver, content-addressed root and typed class hierarchy
family_profiles.Eco-Grex: habitat, ecological corridor, monitoring-series, network interaction, environmental provenance and local uncertainty
family_profiles.Römer-Grex: geometry, CAD, production interfaces, corridor/Mark/Luke, orbit/field models with distinct physical witness gates
family_profiles.EMASSC: source-owned experimental evidence, IP rights, protocol/test-run and engineering authority review
family_profiles.SAI: Shared Australian Intelligence public/private consented utility, scoped national and local-first projection with no government authority implied
family_profiles.LightSpeed: existing leased local/runtime execution and queued progress receipts; never a second source root
family_profiles.International: consented individually named federated sources only, with per-source rights and jurisdiction; no automatic access or sovereign claims

storage_placement_intent.authority: do not move, rename, overwrite or recursively absorb native .cgx carriers until host filesystem manifest, backups, links, free space, rights and cross-drive references are verified
storage_placement_intent.mapping_rule: logical CGX mount/namespace first, physical volume mapping after existing root conflict checks and operator-approved exact move manifest; do not assume E: exists
storage_placement_intent.publication: public-safe kitset by explicit object/field/IP/privacy approval, reproducible source snapshot, license, hashes, negative static leak check and rollback; no private 605-object catalogue, 411-geometry atlas, 16 internal 4K assets or credentials by default

mesh_and_render_projection.source: existing CGX atlas, 2D/3D renderer, 4D state and PR173 geometric observer selection; reuse current Press and LS GO rather than adding new renderer
mesh_and_render_projection.recomputation: invalidate only impacted descendants, regenerate changed authorized view meshes and render-cache entries; do not imply every child has a real 3D asset
mesh_and_render_projection.printspace: directional X_to_Y process, environment, curing, encapsulation, native material witness and safe-state explicitly independent from semantic shape selection
mesh_and_render_projection.side_effects: all changes default preview-only, no installed app patch, physical machine action, external outreach send or release from this contract

distributed_observation.offered: n scoped nodes/lenses, default candidate 3-of-5 only when five independent admitted observations are actually available
distributed_observation.safeguards: correlated/common-source observations count only as supported evidence; signed device identity, ACL, current lease, replay protection and verified prior root are separate mandatory controls
distributed_observation.status: SIMULATED_LOCAL_CANDIDATE; two physical authorized nodes and node_exchange DS-01..08 remain independent acceptance gates

hydration_scatter_projection.owner: existing semantic_view_lens_registry; no new semantic state
hydration_scatter_projection.rule: A lens requests the minimum hydration planes and receives source-bound FKC references or safe unresolved states. It may scatter one admitted object into several views but cannot mint source, state, authority or witness.

H5_LENS: all registered lenses subject to view_selection_policy

fract_key_display.public: do not expose private source/root fingerprints; use approved public projection IDs

orthogonality: semantic XY/Z/T is not LightSpeed runtime Z-floor
FKC hydration plane is not a geometry dimension
Morton3 chunk address is not a semantic layer
N layers, N lenses, N nodes and N devices are independently selected counts
